currency_assumptions: Venue prices are researched and stored in KRW (cost_local_amount / cost_local_currency = KRW). The soft budget and every USD figure use the ECB euro foreign exchange reference rates dated 2026-11-27 and fetched 2026-11-28: EUR 1 = USD 1.0957 and EUR 1 = KRW 1462.65, giving USD 1 = KRW 1334.9001 and 1 KRW = USD 0.00074912. See fx_evidence_2026-11-28.md for the derived cross rate and four hand recomputations.

Where a venue publishes a full-day or package rate, that figure is the recorded amount (DDP 11-hour day, 판교 08:00-17:00 day, COCOC 9-hour package, 노들섬 weekend day, 마로니에 8-hour block sum). Where only an hourly rate exists, the recorded amount is that rate multiplied by 8 hours and the record carries cost_basis estimated_from_rate with estimated_hours 8 and a final-quote question (COCOC 컨퍼런스룸 A, 몽상가들 서브 세미나룸, 마로니에공원 다목적홀). Where no readable price exists, estimated_cost_usd is null with a cost_unknown question (COEX rooms, KT&G 상상마당, 스페이스쉐어, 성공 스페이스).
holiday_and_school_context_note: Only the KR public holiday rows are used for date context, taken from the plan-event registry edition 2027년 월력요항 (우주항공청공고 제2026-0078호, 관보게재일 2026-06-29): 설날 2027-02-06..08 with substitute 2027-02-09, 추석 2027-09-14..16, plus the other fifteen 2027 public dates. The KR:seoul school authority exists as an ID but carries no holiday rows and no coverage rows, so the Seoul school lane is declared unknown and no school break is asserted anywhere in this package.
open_questions: No date is selected, ranked or recommended in this run. The whole 2027 calendar year was swept without a monthly cut; the venue set is date-independent and every venue carries its own availability question.

Seoul's venue market is split between public/civic halls that publish full rate tables and commercial spaces that publish hourly rates only: five of sixteen records carry no cost at all (COEX 컨퍼런스룸 300, COEX Studio 159, KT&G 상상마당 라이브홀, 스페이스쉐어 컨퍼런스 B룸, 성공 스페이스) and each carries a confirm-cost question instead of an estimate.

Two records carry no headcount (노들섬 노들라운지 states '행사 운영에 따라 상이', KT&G 상상마당 publishes no capacity), which makes them leads rather than selectable venues; the 몽상가들 record keeps a material question because the published rate is for the sub-seminar room while the 70-person limit is not tied to a room.

Alcohol is an event-licence question, not a room amenity: none of the sixteen pages publishes an alcohol permission for a rented hall, so every record carries an explicit licence question; 몽상가들 is the only venue that states alcohol brought in requires separate consultation.

The Seoul school lane is unopened: the registry carries KR:seoul as a curated host but no KR:seoul holiday row and no KR:seoul coverage row, so no Seoul school-holiday date is asserted anywhere in this package.

KBW2027 (Korea Blockchain Week) has no announced date: the organiser site presents KBW2027 applications but prints no 2027 dates, so KBW is recorded as an unknown-date note instead of a calendar row. UDC (Upbit D Conference), Korea Fintech Week 2027, Seoul Fintech Week 2027, Seoul Fashion Week 2027 F/W and an ETH Seoul 2025/2026/2027 edition are likewise unannounced or not found and are carried as notes.

The scorer records meta.event_date as the access date (2026-11-28) because no event date is supplied; that field is a technical artefact of scoring without a date and is not a recommendation anywhere in this bundle.
Nothing here is a booking, a hold, or a partner commitment. Every contact route recorded for the community map is a public page, and no co-host relationship is claimed.

recommendation.rationale: Run A evidence package only. No venue is selected and no date is proposed; Joe decides both from the evidence. The scorer's tiers are recorded in venues.shortlist.json with the ECB-based USD costs.
